== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-commanderpraji-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commander Praji (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image again, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the E card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
